root_cause.text: The removal of recursion-protection from `__rcu_read_unlock()` allows recursive execution of `rcu_read_unlock_special()` when `raise_softirq_irqoff()` triggers ftrace tracing, leading to an infinite loop because there is no check to prevent redundant softirq invocations.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "Commit 5f5fa7ea89dc... removes the recursion-protection code from __rcu_read_unlock()" which invokes a deadloop in `raise_softirq_irqoff()` with ftrace enabled. The patch diff resolves this by checking `if (rdp->defer_qs_pending != DEFER_QS_PENDING)` and setting `rdp->defer_qs_pending = DEFER_QS_PENDING` before calling `raise_softirq_irqoff(RCU_SOFTIRQ)` in `rcu_read_unlock_special()`.
